title: A Gentle Apology
content:
Silence settled between them once again.

The city lights shimmered below while the moon slowly rose above the skyline.

After speaking about Karthik, Shreya quietly lowered her head.

Her voice had become noticeably softer.

Siddu immediately realized he had unknowingly reopened an old wound.

"I'm sorry..."

"I shouldn't have brought him up."

"Let's leave the past where it belongs."

Shreya took a slow breath before offering a small smile.

"It's alright."

"I've learned to live with it."

The two of them stood side by side, quietly watching the moon illuminate the night sky.

After a long silence, Shreya spoke again.

"Siddu..."

"There's something I've wanted to tell you for a long time."

He turned toward her.

"You've always been kind."

"Even after I betrayed your trust..."

"You never hated me."

"You never tried to take revenge."

"You simply accepted everything and moved on."

A faint smile appeared on her face.

"Not everyone has a heart like yours."

She paused before adding,

"The woman who marries you one day..."

"She'll be very lucky."

Siddu simply smiled.

He didn't know how to respond.

After a brief silence, Shreya continued.

"And do you know something else?"

"Sneha still loves you."

Siddu looked at her in surprise.

Shreya nodded.

"Even after all these years..."

"She hasn't forgotten you."

"She's still trying to find a way to come to France."

"She believes in you."

"She believes that the man who refused her wasn't rejecting her..."

"He was only trying to protect her."

"She says the Siddu she knows would never stop loving someone without a reason."

Siddu remained speechless.

His thoughts drifted back to the phone call five years ago.

She still waited for me...?

Even after everything I said...?

His heart felt heavier than ever.

Memories that he had buried deep inside his heart slowly began to resurface.

Sneha's cheerful laughter during their trip...

The way she worried whenever he skipped a meal...

The excitement in her eyes whenever she discovered something beautiful...

Her trembling voice at the airport...

"I love you, Siddu."

He had convinced himself that time would help her move on.

He believed she would eventually find someone better...

Someone who could love her without fear.

But five years had passed.

And she was still waiting.

The realization silently shattered every reason he had once convinced himself to walk away from her.

After a while, he looked at his watch.

"It's getting late."

"We should leave."

Shreya smiled.

"Yes."

Together, they walked toward the elevator.

Neither of them spoke.

The silence between them no longer carried awkwardness.

It carried understanding.

As the elevator slowly descended, neither of them felt the need to fill the silence with words.

Sometimes...

The deepest conversations ended not with more sentences...

But with quiet understanding.

Five years ago, they had parted with misunderstandings between them.

Tonight...

They parted with acceptance.

A few minutes later, they reached the ground floor.

As they approached the parking area, Siddu smiled faintly.

"It was good talking to you again."

Shreya smiled back.

"It was."

She opened the car door but stopped before getting inside.

"Siddu..."

He looked at her.

"I made a terrible mistake years ago."

"I hurt someone who truly cared for me."

"I can't change what I did."

"But I hope you won't repeat my mistake."

She paused.

"Not every woman will betray you."

"Sneha loves you with all her heart."

"Please..."

"Don't walk away from someone who has waited for you all these years."

Her eyes softened.

"And..."

"I'm truly sorry."

"For everything."

Siddu looked into her eyes for a long moment.

Then he smiled gently.

"The past can't be changed, Shreya."

"Holding on to anger would've only hurt me."

"So I chose to let it go."

He paused.

"Take care of yourself."

Shreya's eyes became slightly moist.

She nodded.

"Thank you..."

"For forgiving me."

Siddu nodded gently.

"Take care, Shreya."

"You too, Siddu."

Shreya got into her car.

Siddu watched as she drove away.

A few moments later, he got into his own car.

As he started the engine, only one thought remained in his mind.

Sneha...

She was still waiting for him.

That single thought stayed with him throughout the drive home, refusing to leave his heart.
